full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A, Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 82 S. 2mo 03 June 2010 VICE-MAYOR ROY V. IAYNES Virac, Catanduanes Dear Vice-Mayor Laynes: This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion on the following issues, to wit: "I) Whether or not the sangguniang bayan, pursuant to its power and authority set forth under Section 447 in conjunction with Section 109 and 114 (a) of R.A. 7160, could introduce signific;tnt changes or modifications Of the specific proarams, projects activities (APPs), including the changes in budgetary allocations thereon in the AIPformuIated by the Municipal Development Council; 2) Whether or not the act (sic) the sangguniang bayan in changing or modifying any of the specific programs, projects activities proposed by the Municipal Development Council embodied in the AIP is considered as an ultra vires. In teply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered both queries in DILG Opinion No. 01, series ofeoos. In tho snid legal opinion, we opined that the sanggunian's approval on the projects and formulated by the local development council does not include the at' ority to revise the same since this would render nugatory the purposes and objectives for which local development councils had been institutionalized by the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160). If at all the sanggunian is not amenable to the LDC's approved projects and programs, the said sangguniu should instead return it to the LDC with its comments and recommendations a; for the LDC's proper consideration. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion ror your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . JESU Director III
